name: CORS reflecting request Origin with credentials
attack_scenario: attacker page on evil.com sends a credentialed fetch to the API; the server reflects Origin: evil.com with Allow-Credentials:true, so the attacker's JS reads the victim's authenticated response
negative_test_hint: send a credentialed fetch with Origin header "https://evil.example.com" and assert Access-Control-Allow-Origin does not echo it back

exemplar.explanation: origin:true (or reflecting req.headers.origin) echoes the caller's Origin back as Access-Control-Allow-Origin. Combined with credentials:true this defeats the same-origin policy. An explicit origin allowlist confines credentialed cross-origin access to trusted front-ends.
